newsitem.title: USA: LS Capital says suit against it dismissed.
newsitem.headline: LS Capital says suit against it dismissed.

text.p: LS Capital Corp, formerly Lone Star Casino Corp, said Tuesday a federal court in Wilmington, Del., had dismissed a lawsuit charging it with breach of fiduciary duty.
In a statement, LS Capital said it won a summary judgment in its favor in the lawsuit filed by plaintiff Truman Susman.

LS Capital said the court ruled that Susman had not produced sufficient evidence to establish that Lone Star knowingly participated in the alleged breach of fiduciary duty, quoting the decision on the case.
LS Capital said the judgment was also in favor of its president and Chief Executive Paul Montle on all similar complaints bought by Susman against him.
LS Capital was spun off to shareholders of Viral Testing Corp in Mah 1993.
